ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; low-intensity (dark) pixels occupy the central fluke area and outer margins, while high-intensity (white/off-white) pixels occupy roughly 45% of the surface area across the lateral lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two distinct contiguous high-intensity regions on distal lobes; left lobe contains a large white patch with a 'feathered' inner boundary and yellowish-brown tinting near the top; right lobe contains a similar white patch with increased internal low-intensity mottling; both regions are framed by a solid dark border.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped vertex approximately 50 degrees; depth of notch is prominent, bisecting the two lobes symmetrically.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, medium-amplitude irregular serrations; sharp pixel variations creating a 'saw-tooth' profile across the continuous boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-curvilinear; concave transition from the median notch followed by a broad convex arc toward the fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple localized circular low-intensity pixel clusters (mottling) scattered within the high-intensity white fields on both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged indentation on the distal trailing edge of the right lobe suggesting historic tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Yellowish-brown pixel tinting at coordinates corresponding to the upper-distal region of the left lobe's white patch.
